verdict.rationale: Isaac's own documentation names teleoperation as a capability: Isaac ROS lists teleoperation among its production-ready packages, GR00T supports teleoperation "on a physical robot" for capturing demonstrations, and Isaac Sim mentions Isaac TeleOp. However, this teleoperation is framed mainly as a way to collect training data, and nothing describes an ops-facing remote control experience. missing for 10: live video streaming to the operator, latency/responsiveness guarantees over real-world (WAN/cellular) networks, remote-operation tooling or UI documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
